set-variable.name: dlpHit

return-response.set-body: @{ return new JObject(new JProperty("verdict","block"), new JProperty("stage","dlp"), new JProperty("reason","DLP pattern matched: "+(string)context.Variables["dlpHit"])).ToString(); }

set-variable.name: maxSev

return-response.set-body: @{ return new JObject(new JProperty("verdict","block"), new JProperty("stage","content-safety"), new JProperty("maxSeverity",(int)context.Variables["maxSev"])).ToString(); }
